ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the slope of the water-facing side of the river embankment, with a height of $AC=1$ and a horizontal distance $BC=\sqrt{3}$. What is the slope of the slope $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Let $\because$ the height of the slope $AC=1$, the horizontal distance $BC=\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore$ the gradient of the slope $AB$ is $\tan B=\frac{AC}{BC}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}=\boxed{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}}$.
